fieldName: Chance of an offer per bar
fieldDescription: Chance in percent that a bar has a tiered mission on offer. Each bar rolls again when its offers refresh, about every 20 to 40 days.

How much the tier roll favours tiers that match your fleet size, colony income and credits. 0 is fully random. 100 makes the matching tier twice as likely and its neighbours one and a half times. Every tier in the range below stays possible.
Bars never offer contracts below this tier. If it is set above the highest tier, the two swap.
Bars never offer contracts above this tier.
Carry the client's cargo to another market.
Deliver the client's fuel from your own tanks. Every jump burns into the delivery.
Carry contract workers in your crew quarters.
Bring goods you find or buy yourself, or a colony item at tiers 4 to 6, to a construction project.
Put up a stake now, get it back with profit after 5 to 12 months.
Destroy a hostile fleet. From tier 5 the enemies are Omega, Threat, Shrouded Dwellers and other horrors, never pirates.
Raid a market to knock out one of its industries, or bring your marines to a garrison.
Haul supplies to a camp in an uncolonised system. The offer says how likely an ambush is.
Carry weapons, drugs or organs to a market where they are illegal. Patrols that scan you will take them and your standing.
Multiplies every credit reward and investment payout.
Multiplies the fleet points of every enemy fleet a combat contract or an expedition ambush sends.

Every bar gets an extra option to spawn any job type at any tier, ignoring the job type and tier settings above, and open contracts get buttons to complete or fail them at once. Leave it off for normal play.
